Name: Magic Bullet
Components: S, M (a piece of ammunition kissed by a devil)
Description: You insert a piece of ranged ammunition in a ranged weapon, infusing it with pure, violent magic through a magic circle that appears at the barrel or point of your weapon. You then shoot in a direction of your choice, covering a 5-ft wide and 60-ft long line of land as the bullet explodes in a nearly blinding flash, never truly missing a target. All creatures within range must pass a Dexterity saving throw or suffer 1d10 force damage, or half on a success.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 1st.
